title: DR + AWS Backup — RTO/RPO and centralized backup policies
topic: RTO/RPO, DR strategies (backup-restore, pilot light, warm standby, active-active), AWS Backup vault/plan/selection, tag-based enrollment, cross-Region copy, vs DynamoDB PITR and Aurora native backups
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-19-dr-aws-backup.md and night-19-lab-backup-setup scripts. Answer without peeking at night-19-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: After a bad deploy, GSA wiki counters are wrong. Leadership says losing more than 30 minutes of view data is unacceptable. Which metric are they defining?

options.A: RPO — maximum acceptable data loss measured in time
options.B: RTO — maximum acceptable downtime before service returns
options.C: MTTR — mean time to repair the Lambda deployment package
options.D: TTL — DynamoDB item expiration for stale wiki pages

questions.question: us-east-1 fails. Executives require the public wiki back online within 15 minutes. Which metric drives the architecture choice?

options.A: RPO — how much wiki data can be missing after failover
options.B: Backup vault retention — days recovery points are kept
options.C: RTO — maximum acceptable outage duration before users can read wiki pages
options.D: ACU floor — minimum Aurora capacity during disaster

questions.question: A startup accepts hours of downtime after a Region failure but wants the lowest monthly DR cost. Which strategy fits?

options.A: Multi-site active-active with DynamoDB global tables in three Regions
options.B: Backup and restore — AWS Backup recovery points plus IaC redeploy in DR Region
options.C: Warm standby with Route 53 failover to a running ASG min=2 in us-west-2
options.D: Pilot light with Aurora Global Database primary in both Regions

questions.question: Compare pilot light and warm standby for the same RPO target. Which statement is correct?

options.A: Pilot light keeps full production ASG capacity running in DR at all times
options.B: Warm standby never runs database instances until failover is declared
options.C: Pilot light and warm standby have identical RTO because both use AWS Backup only
options.D: Warm standby runs a scaled-down but live DR stack — lower RTO than pilot light

questions.question: Compliance wants one nightly retention policy for DynamoDB wiki tables, Aurora resort_stats, and EBS volumes. Which approach?

options.A: AWS Backup plan with tag-based selection (Night 19 lab pattern)
options.B: Enable DynamoDB PITR only — it automatically backs up all account resources
options.C: Extend RDS automated backup window to cover EBS and DynamoDB in the same job
options.D: CloudTrail data events on every PutItem and INSERT for 90-day replay

questions.question: night-19-lab tags saa-study-gsa-wiki-views with saa-study-backup=night-19 instead of listing the table ARN in the plan. Why?

options.A: DynamoDB tables cannot be backed up by ARN — tags are mandatory
options.B: Tags disable PITR so AWS Backup becomes the only restore path
options.C: New resources with the same tag auto-enroll without editing the backup plan
options.D: Tag keys must match the backup vault name or jobs fail IAM checks

questions.question: Aurora resort_stats needs sub-second cross-Region RPO with a managed global primary/secondary topology. Best fit?

options.A: Promote a read replica in eu-west-1 after us-east-1 outage
options.B: Aurora Global Database with primary in us-east-1 and secondary in eu-west-1
options.C: RDS Multi-AZ synchronous standby in the same Region only
options.D: AWS Backup cross-Region copy every five minutes as live replication

questions.question: An auditor asks whether CloudTrail can replace AWS Backup for wiki tables. What is accurate?

options.A: Yes — CloudTrail stores full table snapshots in the trail S3 bucket
options.B: Yes — EnableCloudTrail on DynamoDB streams equals PITR plus AWS Backup
options.C: Partially — CloudTrail replaces backup if S3 Object Lock is enabled
options.D: No — CloudTrail records API activity; it is not a backup and restore service

questions.question: You add a copy action to saa-study-gsa-night19-plan targeting a vault in us-west-2. What crosses Regions?

options.A: Recovery points copied on the schedule defined in the backup plan rule
options.B: Live DynamoDB item replication like global tables active-active writes
options.C: Continuous PITR log streams forwarded to the DR vault in real time
options.D: CloudFormation stacks that redeploy Lambda and API Gateway automatically

questions.question: A teammate confuses AWS Backup cross-Region copy with DynamoDB global tables. How do they differ?

options.A: Global tables copy only manual snapshots; Backup copy handles PITR
options.B: Both are identical — AWS Backup implements global tables internally
options.C: Backup copy moves periodic recovery points; global tables replicate live writes
options.D: Global tables require AWS Backup vault lock in the destination Region

questions.question: night-19-lab creates saa-study-gsa-backup-vault. What is the vault's primary role?

options.A: Run Lambda functions that poll DynamoDB Streams for backup triggers
options.B: Encrypted container storing backup recovery points with optional vault lock
options.C: Route 53 health check target for DR failover routing policies
options.D: IAM boundary that replaces the AWSBackupDefaultServiceRole

questions.question: Before a risky Aurora schema migration on resort_stats, ops wants a one-off snapshot they control. Best action tonight?

options.A: Disable automated backups until migration completes successfully
options.B: Switch the cluster to DynamoDB to avoid relational backup complexity
options.C: Enable PITR on the EBS root volume of the Aurora writer instance
options.D: Start an on-demand AWS Backup job or manual RDS snapshot before the change

questions.question: night-19-lab-backup-teardown.ps1 runs after the quiz. A teammate worries the wiki study table disappears. What is true?

options.A: Teardown removes Backup resources only — Night 18 saa-study-gsa-wiki-views remains
options.B: Teardown deletes any DynamoDB table tagged saa-study-backup=night-19
options.C: Teardown disables PITR on prod WikiPages in the production account
options.D: Teardown drops Night 16 Aurora because backup plans reference the VPC

questions.question: GSA needs near-zero RTO with active writes in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 for DynamoDB wiki pages. Which DR tier?

options.A: Backup and restore with weekly recovery points in a second Region
options.B: Pilot light — AMIs only, no database running until declared disaster
options.C: Multi-site active-active — e.g. DynamoDB global tables plus regional endpoints
options.D: Warm standby — single Region Multi-AZ with read replica for reports

questions.question: Night 15 enabled Aurora automated backups. Night 19 enrolls the same cluster in AWS Backup by tag. Why keep both concepts straight?

options.A: Automated backups are required to disable before any AWS Backup plan can run
options.B: AWS Backup can centralize retention across Aurora, DynamoDB, and EBS; native backups are per-service
options.C: Aurora automated backups only work when DynamoDB PITR is enabled on wiki tables
options.D: AWS Backup replaces Aurora storage and removes the need for a writer instance
